summary: Frontend-only e2e verification after removal of localStorage Bearer-token storage (cookie-only auth). Ran two Playwright suites against the preview URL: public homepage + search, anonymous /admin guard, admin login (admin@geoarchive.io/admin123), KML upload, Home card appearance, MapDetail (Leaflet preview + download buttons), delete, logout, post-logout /admin guard, invalid-credential handling, invalid-extension rejection, and mobile (390x844) rendering. ALL flows passed: 11/11 frontend scenarios green. localStorage contains no auth token (only posthog key); httpOnly `access_token` cookie is set on login and cleared on logout; all /api calls returned 200 with credentials.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout: 6 consecutive wrong-password attempts all returned 401 and a valid login immediately succeeded afterwards. Auth playbook requires lockout after 5 failures.
Response body still returns the raw JWT (`token`) even though the frontend is now cookie-only — remove it to avoid exposing the token to JS/XSS.
Cookie set with secure=False, samesite='lax' hardcoded; app is served over HTTPS (ingress currently upgrades it to Secure/SameSite=None). Should be secure=True and samesite configurable via env.

allow_origins defaults to '*' together with allow_credentials=True — an invalid combination for credentialed cross-origin requests. Works today only because frontend and API share the same origin. Set explicit origins from CORS_ORIGINS.

issues: Sonner toast (top-right) overlaps/partially covers the header Logout button while visible — cosmetic overlay, button becomes temporarily hard to click
GET /api/auth/me returns 401 for every anonymous visitor, producing a red console error on page load; consider a non-error probe or suppressing the log

action_items: Implement login brute-force lockout (5 failed attempts) per auth playbook
Stop returning the JWT in the /api/auth/login response body (cookie-only now)
Set cookie secure=True (env-driven samesite) and use explicit CORS origins instead of '*' with allow_credentials
Optional: reposition/offset the admin toast so it does not overlap the Logout button
critical_code_review_comments: Auth cookie flags are hardcoded (secure=False, samesite='lax'); make them environment-driven so production is Secure/None-safe.
allow_origins='*' + allow_credentials=True is silently invalid for cross-origin browsers; only same-origin routing hides it.
Login endpoint has no rate limiting / failed-attempt counter.
AdminDashboard uses raw fetch() for upload while every other call uses the shared axios instance — consider unifying on http for consistent credential handling.

success_rate.backend: not tested this iteration (42/42 in iteration_1)

seed_data_creation: Uploaded and then deleted a QA KML map 'QA_KML_TEST_1'. Also RESTORED the pre-existing map 'Gor Tombolotutu' which had been soft-deleted (is_deleted:true) by iteration_1 backend test cleanup — verify this was intended; iteration_1 cleanup appears to have deleted a non-TEST_ record.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cookie-only auth verified end-to-end on the preview URL: login sets httpOnly access_token, /auth/me works, upload via fetch with credentials:'include' works, logout clears the cookie and re-guards /admin. Reusable KML fixture at /app/tests/qa_test_map.kml. Remaining open items are security hardening (lockout, token in body, cookie flags, CORS wildcard) — no functional frontend defects.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional regression found from the localStorage removal. Homepage initially appeared empty because all earlier map documents were soft-deleted (is_deleted:true) by iteration_1 test cleanup, not because of a listing bug.
